name: PolicyLens claims squad
description: Triages one Northgate Mutual homeowners claim: reads the adjuster notes, checks the attached endorsements' coverage clauses and exclusions, and returns a coverage decision with the exclusions relied on and the amount payable. Never states 'covered' without an exclusions check; if that check cannot run it says so.

skills.name: Triage a claim
skills.description: Given a claim number (CLM-YYYY-nnnnn), decide covered / partially_covered / excluded / needs_info, cite every exclusion (E-NN) and clause relied on, and compute the payable amount after the deductible. Output follows the PolicyLens triage contract.

skills.name: Summarise adjuster notes
skills.description: The facts in a claim's adjuster note history that decide coverage: actual cause, timeline and durations, damage lines, and anything that contradicts the first notice of loss. Facts only; no coverage call.
examples: What do the notes on CLM-2026-10005 say caused the water damage?

oauth2.description: Client credentials. Scope claims.triage covers both skills; reading raw adjuster notes additionally needs claims.notes.read.

scopes.claims.triage: Triage a claim and receive the decision
